name: The War of the Teeth and the Armor
aspect: The pre-Brahmi account of the Fang vs Scale wars, read off basalt tablets
notes: Fragments of stone tablets from the deep basalt strata of the Deccan, in an archaic pre-Brahmi script, describe a world split between the Warm-Blooded Ones who walked on fangs and the Sky-Eyed Birds who wore armour of scales. When the world grew too small to hold their fury a tear opened in the high heavens and spilled crimson blood that turned the rivers to boiling rock. The Ammonite Man sang a song of deep-sea silence to soothe the earth; the Owlman gathered the surviving feathers and planted them in the mountain canopies, sealing the rifts under great basalt gates. Shown on the clay seals of Mohenjodaro as a multi-headed beast clashing with a giant bird.
